data.name: Preshti
data.gender_notes: Preshti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from Sanskrit which means to 'delight', 'please', 'enchant' or 'charm'. It is also associated with the concept of 'love' and 'beauty'. The name Preshti carries the meaning “Delight, Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Preshti usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Preshti represents the divine emotion of love, compassion, and the inner beauty of the soul. It is a name that embodies grace, charm, and the ability to bring joy and happiness to those around us.
data.etymology: Preshti belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Preshti total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
